gaps.sentence: The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.

gaps.sentence: ___ the heavy traffic, we arrived on time.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite' is followed by a noun or -ing form, never a finite clause.

gaps.sentence: Cut the onions, fry them gently and ___, stir in the cream.
gaps.hint: the last step of a sequence
gaps.explanation: 'Finally' closes a list of actions; 'firstly' opens one, while 'initially'/'at first' contrast with later events.

gaps.sentence: The prototype is undeniably elegant; it is, ___, hopelessly impractical.
gaps.explanation: 'On the other hand' concedes elegance while introducing the drawback.

gaps.sentence: ___ he had studied hard, he failed the exam.
gaps.explanation: 'Even though' concedes a full clause; due/owing take noun phrases.

gaps.sentence: The course offers not only theory ___ hands-on fieldwork.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only... but also' is the fixed correlative pair.

gaps.sentence: He had hardly stepped off the plane ___ he was rushed into a meeting.
___ had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: The 'than' in the sentence forces 'No sooner', the only linker paired with than.
